root: ^Did you just see what I just saw? The main star just got murdered! What in God’s name is happening?

s: ^Calm down, we need to find out who did this. We’re all suspects, so we need to find evidence to clear our names! What do you know as the stage manager?

g-0: ^Alright, alright, I can tell you all that I know about everyone back here.

c-0: ^Dominic, as you know, was the main star of this play. He was a child star, but as they all do he faded into adulthood. He got mixed up with some bad people. This play was his one chance to get his life together. How wrong did that turn out?
c-1: ^That’s Shannon, Dominic’s wife, or ex-wife. After Dominic got himself a DUI, she seemed to be much more distant. Though anyone would be if their husband was that volatile. I met with her last night, she seemed to be supportive of the play. God only knows what she thinks now that her husband is dead.
c-2: ^You mean Maurice? Haven’t you remembered? Wouldn’t blame you though, he was a nobody vying for the role of the lead for this play who almost landed it, but lost the role. If that were me, I would be pretty resentful and bitter. But overall, he seemed to put up a good performance in the second billing. Can’t be all bad…
c-3: ^That’s Mikhail. Let’s just say he is part of a deal Dominic made with a group, in order to secure funds for this play. As part of that deal, in addition to money Dominic received free security for his play. I don't like the look of the guy however…

ending: ^Try talking to everyone backstage, they might have seen something.
